generate_image_with_sdxl: generate an image from a text prompt using the StableDiffusionXLPipeline
encode_prompt_for_sdxl: encode a text prompt into embeddings using the encode_prompt method
prepare_latents_for_generation: prepare random latent variables for image generation with a specified shape and dtype
rescale_noise_cfg: rescale the noise configuration tensor to fix overexposure in generated images
retrieve_timesteps_from_scheduler: retrieve and configure timesteps from a diffusion scheduler for inference
